sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency: Entry VISA Requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: PICA is Jamaica's immigration authority. Its live entry-visa page publishes the country schedule, but the schedule is dated 19 July 2023 and does not name Vatican City or the Holy See.
sources.supportingExcerpt: PASSPORT, IMMIGRATION & CITIZENSHIP AGENCY – VISA UNIT Last updated July 19, 2023

sources.title: Jamaica Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade: Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade
sources.officialityEvidence: Jamaica MFAFT's live visa page describes consular and port-of-entry issuance but does not assign either route to Vatican City/Holy See ordinary passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of certain countries are able to obtain their visas at the port of entry.

sources.title: Vatican City State ordinary passport specification
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Vatican City State ePassport PDF (last modified 3 January 2026) identifies the current ordinary VA passport, which is a separate travel document from an Italian or Holy See diplomatic passport.

unresolved.reason: No current Jamaican or Vatican primary source directly maps the distinct Vatican City ordinary passport to a Jamaican short-tourist waiver, prior visa, electronic route or port-of-entry visa. PICA's dated country schedule omits Vatican City/Holy See, and MFAFT gives only general issuance guidance. Italy's traveller guidance cannot be transferred to a VA passport.
